new_value: coap_slot_coord.c:339-343: added #else + #error backstop after the CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR verification block, following the house pattern (link/schnorr48.c:222-223, link_ctx.c:268-269). Message: 'slot-coord requires LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR: claim verification must never be compiled out (fail-open backstop)'. Commit 80458a82f6. EVIDENCE: (1) Negative test - compiled the module target with CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR stripped from a patched autoconf.h (-imacros substitution, otherwise identical flags): compile fails at coap_slot_coord.c:340 with exactly the #error message; regression is now a build failure, not silent fail-open. (2) Positive config: with the Kconfig chain enabled (bead wmf0 build) the guard compiles as before and my hunk contributes zero diagnostics in the A/B vs HEAD. (3) Lint profile parity with a corroborating side effect: cppcheck analyzes two preprocessor configs; in the SCHNORR-undefined config HEAD reported the pre-existing uninitvar iid_hex (proving cppcheck really did analyze the verify-compiled-out code), and my #error makes that config un-analyzable so that HEAD-only finding legitimately disappears; in the only real build config (SCHNORR=y) finding sets are identical (17 misc-use-internal-linkage + 2 bugprone-branch-clone + 1 uninitvar + 1 pre-existing zephyr/kernel.h-not-found).
